recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. No current core source follow-up is needed unless OO explicitly reopens the later FHIR-41321 decision and approves new guidance for omitted laboratory result records.
issue_request: FHIR-11294 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request for FHIR-core Observation, raised against DSTU2 section 10.1.7, asking to clarify absent-data examples so implementers would not assume every omitted laboratory result must be represented by one of the existing examples.
initial_application: Commit 29f4601440af8375fc9f1e19f0d38727cd29aec4, whose subject listed [#11294], added the observation-reported-only-when-values-exist and differential-cell-count example to the old Observation.dataAbsentReason spreadsheet source.
additional_context: Current Observation source is active in the build. Later Applied issue FHIR-41321 directly reconsidered the FHIR-11294 narrative and resolved Persuasive with Modification to remove the whole values-to-report, differential-count, and use-case-agreement passage because it did not fit the rest of the dataAbsentReason guidance. Commit c5544079b363fdd536766fd5fbc3fe3bc26550ac removed it, and FHIR-41321 already has a no-change audit on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Reintroducing the original FHIR-11294 wording would undo later OO direction; current Observation.dataAbsentReason and not-performed guidance remains consistent without that superseded passage.
